evals.prompt: Create an MDX project brief that uses callouts, steps, and grouped option cards, then make sure it will render well in render-mdx.
evals.expected_output: The agent authors MDX for the requested brief, imports Aside, Steps, Card, and CardGrid from @mdx-components, avoids inline styling, and does not modify the render-mdx codebase.

evals.prompt: Register docs/plan.mdx with render-mdx without launching the Astro web server.
evals.expected_output: The agent uses render-mdx register docs/plan.mdx, explains that it writes the source registry, and uses RENDER_MDX_HOME for tests or temporary state.

evals.prompt: Write an MDX runbook with OS-specific command tabs and a Mermaid flowchart. The topic is deployment, not render-mdx.
evals.expected_output: The agent imports Tabs and TabItem from @mdx-components, uses a fenced Mermaid block without importing a diagram component, avoids inline styling, and focuses on the deployment document content.

evals.prompt: Create an MDX explanation of one request handler with prose tied to exact source-code line ranges.
evals.expected_output: The agent imports CodeWalkthrough and CodeWalkthroughStep from @mdx-components, passes the full source once, divides the explanation into focused steps with valid one-based line ranges, and avoids inline styling.
